axis_meaning.N_t: all native nodes in tree t

title: TreeLoom: full-tree encoding and ancestry readout

site_encoder.operation: 19→32 GELU→32 tanh; interval mean/max plus count, empty, span; 67→32 tanh

tree_sweep.operation: gated linear child messages divided by child count; sum; base residual+tanh+layernorm; outside recipient exclusion; gated linear→linear→tanh→layernorm; sampled concat64→32tanh

own_state_episode.operation: O[Uh⊙Vh+Wh] where episode size>=2; own-state control used by H050

stable_sample_memory.operation: rank8 forcing U(h_up+h_out) at cut representative; stable sample forward/reverse span-decay; average, current cut-group mean, subtract forcing, O back to32

TreeLoom_encoder_splice.operation: first sweep; three parallel residual injections added to original base; second sweep with identical weights and gates; leaf projection

sampled_projection.operation: concatenate sampled second-sweep upward and outside states; inherited Linear(2d,d) then tanh

genomic_head.operation: one-layer BiGRU 35 input,32 per direction; concat32+64; Linear96→32,GELU,Linear32→4; softmax at prediction

scientific_scope: Architecture schematic only; no experiment, data bank, truth, model checkpoint, fitted probability, or GPU read or execution
sample_colors_denote: persistent sample identity only, not ancestry
output_class_colors_denote: ancestry class columns A=Ana,C=CHG,W=WHG,E=EHG and hypothetical tract; no numerical model predictions are plotted
gray_rows_denote: internal ancestors in all-node B_t; sample-only E_t has no gray rows
highlighted_blue_row: persistent sample q1 in each E_t, fed through an ordered bus to the GRU
